text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"multi-paragraph intro/body/conclusion with topic sentences","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is more clearly structured into sections that develop the argument in a controlled way."},{"evidence":"“teachers main job,” “class period,” “afterschool homework club”","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows more ability to build longer sentences with embedded ideas, even if errors remain."},{"evidence":"“visual learners and ... verbal learners,” “one-on-one class with a teacher”","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay develops its points with more specific supporting details and examples rather than staying general."},{"evidence":"“would be inspired,” “would also be helping their community,” “benefits the students parents”","quality":"development of ideas","description":"The essay explains reasons and consequences more fully, giving its claims more depth."},{"evidence":"“safe place,” “feel welcome, not alone”","quality":"cohesive elaboration","description":"The essay uses repeated and connected ideas to keep the argument moving and reinforce its main point."}]}
